label: S&P 500

label: Semiconductor index (SOX)
change: +0.34% on Tue 17 Nov, the only sector to gain that day, after −5.28% on Mon. Wednesday close not yet published; Nvidia fell 2.9% Wed. Its 2026 gain has shrunk from about 106% in June to about 34%

label: Nvidia after CEO exit
change: −2.9% on Wed 18 Nov despite beating forecasts (Q3 revenue US$115.8bn, +103%; Q4 guided to ~US$130bn). Lowest close since June 2025, reversing a ~3% pre-market gain. The board says it won’t reinstate Jensen Huang and has hired a search firm; it disclosed US$32bn of neocloud agreements, and the WSJ reports an SEC disclosure probe
source: Techi (Nasdaq prices) 18 Nov; ABC News business live 18 Nov; 24/7 Wall St 18 Nov; Yahoo Finance live 18 Nov

label: AMD after Nvidia’s CEO exit
change: Rose modestly on Wed 18 Nov (no closing figure published yet) and gained after hours on Tue with Nvidia’s results. −5.58% on Mon 16 Nov as chips led the sell-off
source: CappNotes 16 Nov; Yahoo Finance live 18 Nov; Yahoo Finance 17 Nov

label: VIX volatility index
change: −3.5% on Wed 18 Nov after +11.1% to 25.46 on Tue, its fourth straight rise
source: Yahoo Finance live 18 Nov; Nexus morning note 18 Nov

label: CoreWeave 5-yr default protection
change: Last published level a record 1,268 bp on 5 Nov; no newer figure. Shares −5% to about US$47 on Wed morning, down 34% in 2026. A new term loan at a 7–7.5% yield is pending, and the CEO says CoreWeave won’t borrow unsecured at current yields. Q4 interest cost guided at US$1.05–1.15bn
source: GV Wire 5 Nov; 24/7 Wall St via Yahoo Finance 18 Nov; Nexus 17 Nov

label: Oracle 5-yr default protection
change: Last published level 296 bp on 2 Nov; recent reports put it near 300 bp. Shares −3.4% on Tue, then flat near US$115 on Wed, about 40% down in 2026. Bondholders have sued over borrowing disclosures. Rated BBB-
source: TradingKey 3 Nov (LSEG data); Nexus morning note 18 Nov; 24/7 Wall St via Yahoo Finance 18 Nov

change: Closed −12.6% on Thu 29 Oct after its revenue and profit miss and −US$9.1bn Q3 free cash flow; ~US$280 on Fri, about 17% below a month ago

label: Meta equity raise
change: Largest equity raise ever, to fund AI build-out; includes preferred shares. Nvidia is investing US$3bn in it. Shares −1.6%
source: Reuters via MarketScreener; Yahoo Finance live; Kitco, 27 Oct

label: US investment-grade bond sales, 2026
change: An all-time annual record, passing 2020, driven by AI borrowing

change: No hyperscaler has cut 2027 plans (Alphabet and Amazon: 'significantly' more). label: US Fed funds rate
change: CME FedWatch puts a 25 bp hike on 9 Dec at ~96%, and 69% odds of 50 bp of hikes by end-January. October minutes: almost all officials see further hikes as likely appropriate; a couple are open to more than 25 bp in December. Governor Waller again floated a half-point hike
source: 24/7 Wall St 18 Nov (CME FedWatch); Yahoo Finance live 18 Nov; StockTitan 18 Nov (Fed minutes)

change: −3.0% on Wed 18 Nov; Brent −2.4% to US$90.93, its lowest since late August. Falling oil eases some of the inflation pressure behind Fed hikes
source: Yahoo Finance live 18 Nov; Euronext/Reuters 18 Nov

change: October CPI +0.4% m/m (0.3% expected), core +0.3% for a third month. BLS did not publish annual rates because October 2025 data are missing. October PPI +0.3% m/m, +6.5% y/y
